name: Deep Fetchling

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: Your predecessors dwelled in the Netherworld's deepest, most treacherous regions. You might cast a denser shadow, have a slower pulse, or find comfort in the embrace of darkness. You gain cold or void resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), chosen when you gain this heritage.
